<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes them.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor. It is instantiated by the system and used by various services to add users and manage user data.

@attribute {Array<Object>} users - The list of users managed by this class. It is initialized when the instance is created and is modified by the `addUser` method.

@throws {Error} This function does not throw any errors.
</DOCSTRING>
